raw:
@c constraint
  var ?rabbit int 1
  var ?cat1 int 1
  var ?cat2 int 1
  var ?cat3 int 1
  var ?due int 0 4
  claim ?rabbit equal 6
  claim ?cat1 equal 2
  claim ?cat2 equal 4
  claim ?cat3 equal 11
  claim ?due equal 0
  require ?rabbit at_least 1
  require ?cat1 at_least 1
  require ?cat2 at_least 1
  require ?cat3 at_least 1
  require ?rabbit equal 1 plus 3 times ?n1
  require ?cat1 equal 1 plus 3 times ?n2
  require ?cat2 equal 1 plus 3 times ?n3
  require ?cat3 equal 1 plus 3 times ?n4
  require ?n1 at_least 0
  require ?n2 at_least 0
  require ?n3 at_least 0
  require ?n4 at_least 0
  task prove

@q query
  select ?due
